# Yevhen Peshynskyi (ikstro)

> Design Automation Engineer · Product Design Technologist, Odesa, Ukraine. Designer since 1997 who now builds the systems behind design work: AI-agent pipelines (Claude Code harnesses), design systems on tokens, and production front ends delivered through AI agents. Five years in airline products: booking used by 20+ airlines, a customer data platform, white-label booking and websites. He sets the architecture, the structure and the checks; agents write the code. Works remotely across time zones, in English.

Also written as: Євген Пешинський, Евгений Пешинский, Yevhen Peshinskyi, Evgeniy Peshinskiy.

## Selected work

- Paximizer CDP (2023–now, in production): a customer data platform for airlines built by AI agents instead of Figma; a Claude Code harness of 5 agents and 13 skills; 96 design-system components, 1,309 Storybook stories; a tester skill that walks every flow by role.
- NewSky (2026, in progress): one booking engine for any airline; 5 agents and 32 skills; one contract for any backend (28 capabilities); an airline styled in a day from one JSON; next, a front end that adapts to each passenger from Paximizer CDP advice.
- PAX Pitch (2026): a presentation and content studio that researches, plans, builds decks and video, and publishes with approvals in Telegram.
- Web and promo design: paximizer.com, wind2ride.app and the WebSky Tech promo site.
- Wind2Ride (2025–now): his own route planner for cyclists that reads the wind; App Store and Google Play; 600+ riders; built solo.
- Tools: Muse (Claude Code skill, open source), Language Tutor (open source), Chameleon and Follow the Path (Figma plugins), claude-commit (VS Code).
- PAX-KB: a knowledge base for AI agents: RAG over 10,005 fragments, an MCP server with 8 tools.
- Earlier, at WebSkyTech (websky.tech, 2021–2023): the WX booking engine (booking products used by 20+ airlines; +5% conversion in an A/B test, preliminary), a white-label airline website, CDP v1.
